scripts.dev:services: concurrently -k -n crm-api,crm-web "npm run dev:mysql --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.app:dev: node scripts/run-with-profile.mjs development npm run dev:services
scripts.db:migrate:dev: node scripts/run-with-profile.mjs development npm run db:migrate:mysql --workspace backend
scripts.test:mysql: node scripts/run-with-profile.mjs test npm run test:mysql:suite --workspace backend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @goodjob/integration-connector-sdk && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace integration-worker && npm run build --workspace @goodjob/local-runner
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @goodjob/integration-connector-sdk && npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend && npm run test --workspace integration-worker && npm run test --workspace @goodjob/local-runner
